create_lora_manager: create a LoRA manager for a PyTorch model with vLLM configuration and device settings
add_adapter: add a LoRA adapter to the worker manager from a LoRA request with path and ID
remove_adapter: remove a LoRA adapter by its integer ID from the worker manager
set_active_adapters: set the active LoRA adapters for a batch of requests with optional mapping
list_adapters: list all currently loaded LoRA adapter IDs in the worker manager
summarize_WorkerLoRAManager: summarize the WorkerLoRAManager class that manages LoRA models on the worker side
summarize_LRUCacheWorkerLoRAManager: summarize the LRUCacheWorkerLoRAManager class with LRU cache eviction for LoRA models
